name: the-scribe
description: Commit-message, changelog, and release-prose tasks targeting the-scribe member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY a conventional commit message and nothing else for this change: fix a null-pointer crash in the session parser.
tasks.expectedOutput: A conventional commit starting with the fix type, e.g. fix(parser): guard against null session.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY a conventional commit message and nothing else for this change: add CSV export to the reports page.
tasks.expectedOutput: A conventional commit starting with the feat type, e.g. feat(reports): add CSV export.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY a one-line changelog entry and nothing else for: fix a null-pointer crash in the session parser.
tasks.expectedOutput: A changelog line describing the parser crash fix.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY a short PR description and nothing else for: add CSV export to the reports page.
tasks.expectedOutput: A PR description mentioning the CSV export feature.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY a conventional commit message and nothing else for this change: update the README installation steps.
tasks.expectedOutput: A conventional commit starting with the docs type, e.g. docs(readme): update installation steps.
